verifications.claim: Paul George was suspended for 25 games without pay on January 31, 2026, for violating the terms of the NBA/NBPA Anti-Drug Program.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Philadelphia 76ers forward Paul George has been suspended without pay for 25 games for violating the terms of the NBA/NBPA Anti-Drug Program" (R4); "Paul George was suspended 25 games without pay for violating the NBA's anti-drug policy" (R2); announced Jan. 31, 2026 (R2, R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm the suspension details, duration, date, and reason.

verifications.claim: According to reports, the suspension was triggered by a failed test after Paul George took an "improper medication" to treat a mental health issue.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "took “improper medication” for an issue about mental health" (R1); "taking an improper medication... seeking treatment for an issue of my own" (R2); "took an “improper medication” while seeking treatment for a mental health issue" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: "Improper medication" for mental health directly supported; "failed test" implied by anti-drug violation but not explicitly stated.

verifications.claim: Paul George linked the mental health issue to frustration over his recovery from an earlier knee injury.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No references mention a knee injury or linking it to the mental health issue.

verifications.claim: Paul George admitted to taking the substance.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "I made the mistake of taking an improper medication. I take full responsibility for my actions" (R1, R2); "he made the mistake of taking an “improper medication”... accepted full responsibility" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes from George admitting to taking the medication.

verifications.claim: Paul George stated, "I made a mistake at that moment."
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "I made the mistake of taking an improper medication" (R1, R2)
verifications.reasoning: Similar phrasing exists but exact quote "I made a mistake at that moment" does not appear; presented as direct quote but mismatched.

verifications.claim: Paul George noted the pressure he felt as a leader with the Philadelphia 76ers.
verifications.label: OMITTED
